title: Adding identical machines
caption: Intensities add, not decibels. N identical machines give N times the intensity, so the level rises by 10 log₁₀ N: four 80 dB machines make 86 dB, not 320 dB. Each doubling adds only 3 dB.
alt: Bar chart of sound level: one machine 80 dB, two 83.0, four 86.0, eight 89.0.
